entities.name: Trade Marketing function, Meridian Spirits Group

evidence.raw_text: Aurelia Agave hosted its Agave Nights residency at Orbit Zero Lagos from June 2024 to February 2025.
Meridian Spirits Group owns Aurelia Agave. Bisi Ekwueme leads the Trade Marketing function at Meridian Spirits Group and says the group wants to run a new Lagos venue programme in 2027.
Meridian Spirits Group is seeking a Lagos venue partner for a 2027 residency programme and has allocated a regional activation budget for it.
Tolu Adebayo, programming lead at Orbit Zero Lagos, introduced Bisi Ekwueme to the venue team in September; the two are now planning a joint session.
Agave Nights at Orbit Zero Lagos ended in March 2025.
